'''Orman's Sky Palace''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]], in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Lola Curich]]. It was one of the planet's best-known establishments, boasting the city's longest bar that was able to seat dozens of patrons. It was owned by the free [[Chev]] [[Orman]].

==Description==
Orman's Sky Palace was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Lola Curich]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]], not far from the [[Lola Curich Starport]]. Like most [[Liann]] buildings, the structure had no windows, with only a front door providing access for patrons, a door in the kitchen leading to the alley, and a door for the private garage beneath the building. The main area of the Sky Palace could accommodate hundreds of patrons. To the immediate right of the front door were thirty-two booths arranged in groups of four along the wall. Each group was accompanied by a faded [[holograph]] depicting one of the worlds of the [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion sector]] including the [[Tree/Legends|forests]] of [[Amarin]], [[Spinax III]]'s [[Ocean/Legends|seascape]], pre-industrial bright skies on Lianna itself, [[Desargorr]]'s [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]], a ruined fortress on [[Dravione]], [[Embaril]]'s hills and lakes, deserts and ruins on [[Cadinth]], and [[Chandaar]]'s city of [[Ambaril]]. Dozens of tables filled the middle of the floor.<ref name="ML" />

The bar was the longest in the city, and was a series of long sweeping curves that could seat dozens of customers at once. It was made of polished [[Lizard/Legends|lizard]] skin from Cadinth. Three [[Bartender/Legends|bartenders]] staffed the bar during busy periods. The performance stage was a bright blue, and set a meter above the floor. A combination of [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojectors]], movable poles and lights, along with sound and haze generators, were present to aid performances. The bar had [[Toilet/Legends|restrooms]] catering to both dominant [[Gender/Legends|sexes]], male and female.<ref name="ML" />

The private areas of Orman's Sky Palace were reserved for the staff and visiting entertainers. [[Orman]] maintained a well-appointed office on the premises, decorated in white with a desk, [[Computer/Legends|computer]], and couch. Orman was usually on the premises during the establishments opening hours. There were three dressing rooms for the various entertainers to get ready in, and a prop room containing stage equipment. A large kitchen catered to the patrons, and included three [[Chef/Legends|cooks]], two busboys, and two dishwashers. It was stocked with modern appliances including two [[reconstitution vat]]s. Three storerooms were used to store the food and [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]]. A private garage was located under the premises, with a ramp to street level. It usually contained private [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] belonging to the staff and a couple of [[scooter]]s.<ref name="ML" />

==Occupants==
===Employees===
Orman's Sky Palace was owned by [[Orman]], a free [[Chev]] businessman. His primary goal was to make money, and often [[Spy/Legends|spied]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and turned in suspected [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents for a fee. He employed several thugs to assist him in his business dealings. These thugs included the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Ekh]] the Red, [[Sandi]], and [[Fish (thug)|Fish]], the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Steef]], the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Wheade Daud]], and the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Adon'aris]]. [[Fessi]] was a female Human who worked as a dancer at the Sky Palace.<ref name="ML" />

===Customers===
The customer base of Orman's Sky Palace was diverse; [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], [[loan shark]]s, [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], and [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies]] employees were all known to frequent the establishment.<ref name="ML" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Orman's Sky Palace was the site of a rendezvous between a group of Alliance to Restore the Republic agents and [[Jenna Lars]], an operative on the planet. Initially, it was a simple drop to pass information on to the local Alliance cell regarding sector wide plans. However, during their arrival on Lianna, the agents had witness the Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in orbit attempting to recover a modified [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] with a new [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]]. Lars arranged for the agents to meet with the main Alliance contact on the planet, [[Terri Karl]], where they embarked on a mission to steal the plans to the cloaking device and corrupt the Imperial's data.<ref name="ML" />
